meta.appDescription: The easiest way to split expenses with friends

hero.title: The easiest way to split expenses with friends
hero.subtitle: Track shared expenses, split bills effortlessly, and settle up quickly. Stop worrying about who owes whom.

capybaras.alt: Kapibarat ravintolassa — älä ole se, joka tarttuu laskuun

kittens.alt: Kissat avaruudessa jakavat pizzan — Splittaa: jaa se. rentoudu.

featuresSection.title: Everything you need to split expenses
featuresSection.subtitle: Our platform gives you all the tools to manage shared expenses easily.

groupExpenses.title: Group expenses
groupExpenses.description: Create groups for roommates, trips, or events and keep spending organized.

smartSettlements.title: Smart settlements
smartSettlements.description: Our algorithm minimizes the number of payments needed to settle up.

spendingAnalysis.title: Spending insights
spendingAnalysis.description: Track spending habits and discover insights from your shared expenses.

paymentReminders.title: Payment reminders
paymentReminders.description: Automatic reminders for open balances and spending insights.

splitMethods.title: Multiple split methods
splitMethods.description: Split equally, by percentage, or exact amounts — fits any situation.

realtimeUpdates.title: Real-time updates
realtimeUpdates.description: See new expenses and payments as soon as friends add them.

howItWorksSection.title: Splitting expenses has never been this easy
howItWorksSection.subtitle: Follow these simple steps to start tracking and sharing expenses with friends.

step1.title: Create or join a group
step1.description: Start a group for roommates, a trip, or an event and invite friends.

step2.title: Add expenses
step2.description: Record who paid and how the bill is split among members.

step3.title: Settle up
step3.description: See who owes whom and record payments when debts are cleared.

annikki.quote: Splittaan avulla en enää mene sekaisin siitä, kuka maksoi mitäkin!

luigi.quote: Splittaan avulla pidän tarkkaa kirjaa saatavistani. Se päihittää jopa parhaat muistutussovellukset!

antti.quote: Jos minulla olisi ollut Splittaa aiemmin, Luigi ei olisi päässyt myymään kenkiäni ja takkiani! Lisään velan heti listalle.

balance_basics.title: What is a balance?
balance_basics.body: Splittaa shows who owes whom. Dashboard balances sum debts — green means you're owed, red means you owe.

dashboard.title: The dashboard shows your situation
dashboard.body: On the dashboard you see total balance, spending summary, and groups. Open balance details for person-level views.

new_expense.title: Add a new expense
new_expense.body: Enter description, amount, and participants. Split equally, by percentage, or exact amounts. Mark who paid separately.

groups.title: Groups simplify shared expenses
groups.body: Create a group from contacts or join with a code. Group expenses pre-fill participants from members.

personal_debt.title: Personal debts and debt requests
personal_debt.body: Track debts between two people without a group. In Inbox you can send debt requests or mark debts paid.

multi_currency.title: Multi-currency on trips
multi_currency.body: Pick the expense currency when adding. Splittaa displays amounts in your chosen currency.

finish.title: You're all set!
finish.body: Next, add your first expense. The guide is always in the header if you need a reminder.
